item.title: Majokko★roid Kururu-chan
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: A2
  • 発売日: 2000-03-24
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔女ッ娘★ロイド クルルちゃん
  • 英語名: Majokko★roid Kururu-chan

あらすじ

This story is set in a happy, yet embarrassing near future…

Cars running through tubes and a much closer moon are just a sign of the times.

Of course even in the future the main job of a student is to study, and that’s where we are now. Our good ol’ St. Maria Academy is having its student counsel elections for its senior class in accordance with its unimpeachable, unsurpassable, totally peaceful school rules. Instead of going to class, candidates spend their hellish days in fierce debates. A plane with candidates on it hovers over the school, trying to buy votes with meal tickets for the school cafeteria.
